message.content: {"caption":"Prompt template for scoring the correctness of an answer","description":"A rounded rectangular box contains a monospaced evaluation prompt. It asks a judge to compare a question, its ground-truth answer, and an agent’s answer, then assign a score from 0.0 to 1.0. Bullet points define score bands from completely incorrect or irrelevant to a perfect or equivalent answer. The final instruction requests only a numeric score.","figure_type":"other","chart_values":[]}
